     Cite the software here, every package with [@R-glmmTMB]:
     write_packages_bib() writes those keys into references/packages.bib at

     manuscript and keeps the analysis reproducible: keep it at the end of

The manuscript was written in Quarto, and its rendered documents and its data
and code compendium were produced with easypaper [@R-easypaper]; the versions
of the R packages were recorded with renv [@R-renv] and can be restored from
`renv.lock`.
